title: Customer Service and Complaints
ringkas: Menangani keluhan, meminta maaf, menawarkan solusi
goals: menyapa pelanggan dan menanyakan kebutuhannya dengan ramah
mendengarkan keluhan dan **berempati**: [[I understand how frustrating that must be.]]
meminta maaf secara profesional: [[I apologise for the inconvenience.]]
menenangkan pelanggan yang marah dan mengeskalasi masalah dengan sopan

lesson.text: Pelanggan yang kecewa bisa menjadi pelanggan setia jika keluhannya ditangani dengan baik. Kuncinya ada pada empat langkah: **dengarkan, berempati, beri solusi, dan tindak lanjuti**. Unit ini memberimu bahasa yang tepat untuk setiap langkah.

lesson.title: 1. Empat langkah menangani keluhan
table: [[I understand how frustrating that must be.]]
[[Here's what I can do for you.]]

lesson.title: 2. Menyapa dan menanyakan kebutuhan
table: [[Good morning. Welcome to ... How can I help you?]]
[[What can I do for you today?]] / [[How may I assist you?]]
[[Could you tell me more about the problem?]]
[[May I have your order number, please?]] / [[Could I have your name?]]
[[Let me check that for you.]] / [[Could you hold on a moment?]]

lesson.title: 3. Empati dan permintaan maaf
table: [[I understand how you feel.]] / [[I can see why you're upset.]]
[[I'm very sorry about that.]] / [[I apologise for the inconvenience.]]
[[Thank you for bringing this to our attention.]] / [[Thank you for your patience.]]
[[I'll personally make sure this is fixed.]]

lesson.title: Hindari menyalahkan pelanggan
lesson.text: Jangan berkata [[That's your fault.]] atau [[You should have read the instructions.]] Gunakan bahasa netral: [[Let me see what went wrong.]] / [[It seems there was a misunderstanding.]]

items.ex: You will get a full refund.
I'll escalate this to my manager.
We will resolve the issue today.
We offer a discount as compensation.

lesson.title: 5. Menawarkan solusi
table: [[I can offer you a refund or a replacement.]]
[[Would you prefer a refund or an exchange?]]
[[First, I'll process your request. Then you'll receive an email within 24 hours.]]
[[It will be delivered within three working days.]]
[[Unfortunately, we are unable to ..., but what I can do is ...]]
[[I'll pass this to my supervisor, who will contact you today.]]

lesson.title: 6. Menangani pelanggan yang marah
table: [[Please let me assure you that we will fix this.]]
[[I understand. Let's find a solution together.]]
[[I'm afraid that's not possible, but I can ...]]
[[Is there anything else I can help you with?]] / [[Thank you for calling. Have a good day.]]

lines.en: Good morning. This is Dina from Customer Service. How can I help you?
lines.id: Selamat pagi. Saya Dina dari Layanan Pelanggan. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

lines.en: Hello. I ordered a lamp last week, but it arrived damaged.
lines.id: Halo. Saya memesan lampu minggu lalu, tetapi barangnya tiba dalam keadaan rusak.

lines.en: I'm very sorry about that, Mr. Wijaya. Could I have your order number, please?
lines.id: Saya mohon maaf, Pak Wijaya. Boleh saya minta nomor pesanannya?

lines.en: Thank you. I can offer you a full refund or a replacement. Which would you prefer?
lines.id: Terima kasih. Saya bisa menawarkan pengembalian uang penuh atau barang pengganti. Mana yang Bapak pilih?

lines.en: Certainly. It will be delivered within three working days. I apologise for the inconvenience.
lines.id: Baik. Barangnya akan dikirim dalam tiga hari kerja. Saya minta maaf atas ketidaknyamanannya.

lines.en: This is the third time my order is late! This is unacceptable!
lines.id: Ini ketiga kalinya pesanan saya terlambat! Ini tidak bisa diterima!

lines.en: I understand how frustrating that must be, and I sincerely apologise.
lines.id: Saya mengerti betapa menjengkelkannya itu, dan saya sungguh minta maaf.

lines.en: Let me check what happened. Could you hold on a moment?
lines.id: Biar saya periksa apa yang terjadi. Bisakah Bapak menunggu sebentar?

lines.en: Okay, but I want it fixed today.
lines.id: Baik, tapi saya ingin ini diselesaikan hari ini.

lines.en: I'll pass this to my supervisor, who will contact you before 3 p.m. today. We will also offer you a discount as compensation.
lines.id: Saya akan meneruskan ini ke atasan saya, yang akan menghubungi Bapak sebelum pukul 3 sore ini. Kami juga akan memberikan diskon sebagai kompensasi.

lesson.title: Nada suara
lesson.text: Bicara **pelan, tenang, dan jelas**. Jangan menyela pelanggan, ulangi inti masalahnya agar ia merasa didengar ([[So, if I understand correctly, ...]]), dan jangan berjanji sesuatu yang tidak bisa kamu penuhi.

items: Empat langkah: **listen → empathise → solve → follow up**.
Empati dan maaf: [[I understand how you feel.]], [[I apologise for the inconvenience.]]
Solusi: [[I can offer you a refund or a replacement.]]; batas: [[within three working days]].
Jika tidak bisa: [[Unfortunately, ... but what I can do is ...]]; eskalasi: [[I'll pass this to my supervisor.]]
